Hi :))

I got this card yesterday in one of my Sabbat War booster packs :

The Coven (Unique master)
Gain a master phase action and put this card into play. Tap to move 2
blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire you control. At the end of
your turn, your predator takes control of The Coven.
[great art by Brian LeBlanc !!]

I don't really understand what this card does.

I get the "Tap to move 2 blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire
you control. At the end of your turn, your predator takes control of
The Coven.".

But it's not clear to me what "Gain a master phase action and put this
card into play." means.

Does it mean that I can 2 masters from now on ?

Does it mean that I can play another master just for this turn, after I
played The Coven ?

Also, does the last sentence mean that my predator just gets to use The
Coven to put blood on his vamps, or does he also get 2 master phases ?

If he does get 2 master phases, is it for just 1 turn too ?

Thanks ;]]

JC H2O

Messages.Author: John Whelan
Messages.Body:
On Sun, 29 Oct 2000 jan_chr...@my-deja.com wrote:

> The Coven (Unique master)
> Gain a master phase action and put this card into play. Tap to move 2
> blood from the blood bank to a ready vampire you control. At the end of
> your turn, your predator takes control of The Coven.
> [great art by Brian LeBlanc !!]
>

> But it's not clear to me what "Gain a master phase action and put this
> card into play." means.

It means that you gain one master phase action (once only, not on an
ongoing basis), which you can use to either play another master card, or
draw a blood from an Investment card, etc. Naturally, the master phase
action you gain must be used immediately (this master phase). Unused
master phase actions are never saved up from turn to turn.

> Does it mean that I can 2 masters from now on ?

No

> Does it mean that I can play another master just for this turn, after I
> played The Coven ?

Yes (or draw a blood off your short term investment.

> Also, does the last sentence mean that my predator just gets to use The
> Coven to put blood on his vamps, or does he also get 2 master phases ?

Just to put blood on the vamps. (This is a card that "benefits
everybody", but since it benefits you immediately, and your prey several
turns later, it is to your overall advantage).

> If he does get 2 master phases, is it for just 1 turn too ?

Card text gives no indication of this. The gaining of an extra master
phase action applies only when the card enters play. Once you have gained
your extra master phase action, THEN the card enters play.

-- John Whelan

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 30 Oct 2000 20:18:37 GMT, Noal McDonald <dhar...@my-deja.com>
wrote:

> Lord Darksword <lord_dar...@my-deja.com> wrote:
>> 1. Unique Master
>> 2. Circulating Unique Master
>> 3. Benefits all...
>
>Sounds like a great incentive for people to pass Reversal of Fortune,
>just before you toss out Millicent Smith.

1. Play the Coven. Play a normal master as well.

2. Tap the Coven and pass it on.

3. After your grandprey uses and passes on the Coven, play another to
contest it (note that your prey never gets to use it). Play a normal
master as well.

4. Minion phase: play Thanks for the Donation. =) Regain your
Coven on your next untap. Repeat until your prey begins beating you
with a stick. (granted, he'll never ACTUALLY contest it with you and
lose pool, but it's an effective way to piss him off.) Another,
possibly better option would be to contest it IMMEDIATELY after
passing it backwards - so if your predator doesn't use it on his turn,
he is faced with either yielding it, giving you a chance to repeat the
process, or trying to keep it and bleeding his grandprey for 1 pool
every turn. :) This could possibly even work if your predator passes
it to his OWN predator, since everyone is going to want to use the
thing. :)

-- Derek

Or, more efficiently:

1. Play the Coven. Tap it right away.
2. Use the free master phase action to play another Coven, contesting it.
3. Play some other master with the extra Master Phase Action.
4. Yield both copies next untap, having gotten benefit without having to
give a good card to your prey.

expensive in terms of cardflow, but it's an unblockable inferior Restoration
that doesn't require an action. Uses with Waste Management Program are left
as an exercise for the reader.
